title: AAPS restarts after attempting a profile change
body:
It took a while before I figured this one out. 
I had the following profiles:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/23278852/141697996-c7178e9d-3eea-4b7f-b310-9d830d6a856f.png)

I was editing profile "Normal week copy"  While changing the ISF value I changed my mind and wanted to go back to another profile. 
I pressed the profile pulldown meny and selected the first profile in the list. I then received a notification box asking if I wanted to discard the changes and change profile. I answered yes.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/23278852/141698551-a50b722c-7f77-4e55-9c3d-8837481b5928.png)

 After selecting the first profile "Normal week" I saw that the option for "Save" was still there when editing the first profile as if I had some unsaved cganges from editing the last profile.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/23278852/141698686-fc9197ec-9a05-4397-a4d7-8cb3f2130747.png)
.
 I made some changes to the "Normal week" profile and saved it. After that I selected the U200 profile. I made some edits and wanted to save and activate the U200 profile. AAPS restarts and U200 was not activated.

Summary:
After testing this several times I see that if you edit and discard the changes for a profile, that profile will be in illegal (Red) state.
Any profile before the illegal profile will be possible to activate, but the profile after the illegal profile can not be activated.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/23278852/141698898-d87a541a-a4cc-4641-b6af-fdf72bb3dbba.png)

There's nothing in the log file, just a restart.

Reporting bugs
--------------
- **Note the precise time the problem occurred** and describe the circumstances and steps that caused
  the problem
- Note the Build version (found in the About dialog in the app, when pressing the three dots in the
  upper-right corner).
- Obtain the app's log files, which can be found on the phone in
  _/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/info.nightscout.androidaps/_
  See https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/EN/Usage/Accessing-logfiles.html
- Open an issue at https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/new
